scope: Original61 simple 8-regular diameter2 graphs with nonadjacent roots u=0,v=1 having exactly three common neighbors, neither root in a triangle, and no other double defect incident with either root; inherited global common-neighbor cap3 and adjacent common-neighbor cap1; all remaining edges free, modulo only nonincreasing R parent-vector lex order.
symmetry: Only R parent-vector nonincreasing lex; ties allowed
forbidden_extra_restrictions: No fixed h, overlap, triangle-free whole graph, global isolated D, Wi pattern, or automorphism
